name: odysseus
description: Deterministic web audit engine: technical/SPA-SEO and accessibility audits, prioritized by an LLM layer that never detects.

scripts.check: pnpm run docs:check && pnpm run plans:check && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run architecture:check && pnpm run audit:code
scripts.architecture:check: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs packages/core/src packages/scanner/src packages/llm/src packages/store/src packages/report/src packages/interface/src packages/cli/src packages/site/app packages/site/lib
scripts.test:deploy: bash deploy/render-server-compose.test.sh && bash deploy/compose.test.sh && bash deploy/odysseus-deploy.test.sh && bash deploy/restic-scripts.test.sh && bash -n deploy/equal-access-ci.sh
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --pretty && tsc -p packages/interface/tsconfig.dashboard.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @odysseus/site exec next typegen >/dev/null && tsc -p packages/site/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.serve:full: pnpm --filter @odysseus/cli... run build && pnpm run serve
